name: Architectural Wood
old_description: CEO - Carol is originally from South Africa. She traveled to the United States in the mid 1980's with her husband, Tony, and immediately began to work as a contract millwork drafter. Over her 36 year career in this industry, Carol has managed numerous high profile and complex projects such as corporate headquarters and professional sports arenas. She has proven herself to be a stand-out by developing a system for producing superior shop drawings as well as for forming an engineering team that takes pride in the quality of their engineering efforts. Carol's positive attitude, as well as her dedication to quality and detail, compliments the company's vision of excellence and the high quality of workmanship for which Architectural Wood LLC is known.
about:
Architectural Wood LLC was founded in 1996 in Ronceverte, West Virginia. The company is led by CEO Carol, who emigrated from South Africa in the mid-1980s with her husband Tony and began a career as a contract millwork drafter. Over a 36-year career in the industry, she managed high-profile projects including corporate headquarters and professional sports arenas, and developed a system for producing superior shop drawings.

The shop specializes in architectural millwork fabrication, working with solid lumber, wood veneer, panels, solid surfaces, plastic laminates, metal, glass, and fabrics. A Weeke Venture 114M 4-axis CNC machining center supports precision machining, while an in-house engineering team produces detailed shop drawings and design services for each project.

Projects have included corporate headquarters and professional sports arenas, serving clients in commercial construction and institutional markets. The company emphasizes a direct partnership approach with clients and maintains relationships with vendors and industry associates.

The operation runs on the motto "Craftsmanship Without Compromise - Service Without Excuse" and the tagline "Top Notch Design, First Class Fabrication." Carol's focus on quality workmanship and a pride-driven engineering culture are cited as the foundation of the company's reputation.

name: Arizona Bakery Sales & Services
old_description: John and Shelia Shaw founded Arizona Bakery Sales Services almost two decades ago in Phoenix, Arizona. We are a full-service bakery and restaurant equipment sales, services, and repair business. We are changing consumers’ perspectives about how they can improve the quality of their restaurant and customer perception through regular maintenance and repair of commercial kitchen equipment.
about:
Arizona Bakery Sales & Services was founded in 2001 by John and Shelia Shaw in Phoenix, Arizona. The business began with a single service van and has since grown to operate from a 14,000-square-foot facility in Mesa, Arizona.

The company provides sales, repair, maintenance, installation, and parts supply for commercial bakery and restaurant equipment. Its technicians service rack ovens, convection ovens, deep fryers, walk-in freezers, steamers, sheeters, and meat slicers. The warehouse stocks over 10,000 OEM and generic parts, and the team also handles equipment calibration and staff training.

The company serves more than 3,200 customers, including boutique bakeries, cafes, restaurants, and grocery chains across Arizona, Utah, New Mexico, and Nevada. It offers both new equipment from manufacturers and a rotating inventory of used equipment.

The founders aimed to shift industry perspective toward regular maintenance as a way to improve kitchen quality and customer perception. Guiding principles emphasize a respectful workplace, diversity, excellence in service, and consistently satisfied customers.

name: Arizona Capacitors Inc
old_description: Arizona Capacitors was founded in 1951 as "West-Cap".  In 2010, Electro Technik acquired our company.  We design and manufacture a broad range of standard and custom wound film capacitors for Industrial and Military Applications.
about:
Arizona Capacitors Inc. operates from Tucson, Arizona, where it was founded in 1951 under the name West-Cap. The company became a subsidiary of Electro Technik in 2010, joining a portfolio of passive electronic component businesses. Its facility is located

The firm designs and manufactures standard and custom wound film capacitors, including metalized plastic capacitors for industrial use. Its product lines encompass EMI/RFI filters, precision resistors (wirewound, current sense, high temperature, high voltage, ultra-precision, and surface-mount), RF/microwave components such as terminations, resistors, attenuators, circulators, and isolators, and magnetics including standard and custom transformers qualified to MIL-STD-1553 and MIL-PRF-27. Custom capabilities include capacitor assemblies with wire harnessing for military vehicles, recessed pass-through capacitors, multi-channel input capacitor/filters, shock-mounted isolated pass-through capacitors, and high-power multi-channel capacitors. Many designs date to the 1950s, and the company cites over 70 years of continuous service.

Arizona Capacitors serves defense, aerospace, medical, telecommunications, grid, power conversion, industrial, and instrumentation markets. The company's ETI Companies matrix shows its film capacitors, magnetics, filters, resistors, and RF/microwave products crossing these sectors. Concrete examples include military vehicle capacitor assemblies, military 4-channel input capacitor/filters, and high-power 4-channel capacitors.

The company emphasizes its long heritage and ongoing development of new products for future applications. It highlights its MIL-STD certification and CAGE code 0TCV9 as indicators of military compliance, and its integration within Electro Technik's three business units—capacitive/resistive, microwave/RF, and magnetics/transformer products—as a source of expanded capability.

name: Arizona Emergency Products
old_description: “As a customer since 2005, we appreciate and value most the high quality installation, expert advice on new innovations and products and the willingness to provide custom design  to fit our agency’s needs. “
about:
American Emergency Products is based in Phoenix, Arizona. The company originated in 2009 when seven separate companies merged to form Soncell North America, which serves as the parent organization. The combined entity began operating as a full-service emergency vehicle up-fitter for public safety and government fleets.

The company specializes in turnkey up-fitting of emergency vehicles, handling everything from lighting and communication installations to custom graphics, painting, and storage solutions. Its five facilities across the Southwest produce more than 2,500 completed vehicles each year, supporting a range of configurations including command units, K9 transports, prisoner transports, and administrative vehicles.

Primary customers include law enforcement agencies, fire and rescue departments, utility providers, and military organizations. The company has supplied vehicles to the United States Forest Service and builds to Ford's Qualified Vehicle Modifier program guidelines.

AEP emphasizes its position as the largest emergency vehicle up-fitter in the Southwest, a scale that allows it to offer integrated design, installation, and project management under one roof. The company highlights its willingness to provide custom designs tailored to specific agency requirements.

name: Arkansas Electrical Outlet Inc
old_description: Arkansas Electrical Outlet, Inc. has been independently owned and operated since 1997, specializing in new and remanufactured electrical supplies and custom-built systems for a variety of industries and clients worldwide.
about:
Arkansas Electrical Outlet, Inc. was founded in 1997 in Forrest City, Arkansas, and has remained independently owned and operated since its inception. The company began as a supplier of electrical equipment and has expanded to offer both new and remanufactured products along with custom-built systems for customers worldwide.

The company’s core offerings include a broad range of electrical apparatus such as buckets, control panels, panel and switchboards, switches and disconnects, bus plugs, motor control equipment, transformers, circuit breakers, motor starters, pump panels, and variable frequency drives. In addition to supplying these components, AEO provides sand blasting and powder coating services and performs custom manufacturing to meet specific client requirements. The facility also handles remanufacturing of electrical supplies, though the company does not disclose its plant size, headcount, or annual production volumes.

AEO serves a variety of industries and clients globally, though the company does not specify particular sectors in its public materials. Its product lineup suggests a focus on industrial, commercial, and utility electrical infrastructure. The recent acquisition by Group CBS brings additional resources, including access to what is described as the largest inventory of low- and medium-voltage apparatus and replacement parts in the United States, along with engineering support, training, remote racking and switching solutions, and specialty test equipment.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, timely delivery, and a commitment to meeting customer needs faster and more affordably than competing manufacturers. This value proposition, combined with the expanded capabilities from the Group CBS partnership, forms the basis of its market positioning.

old_description: When you book an appointment for gates, fencing, doors, and railings, receive a $25 gift card to our showroom. Some exclusions do apply. Please see store for full details, and not valid for home security.
about:
Artistic Iron Works has served the Las Vegas Valley since 1971 from a 33,000-square-foot facility in the downtown Arts District. The company is family-run and veteran-owned, operating as a full-service ornamental iron gallery and custom fabrication shop.

The shop produces custom wrought iron doors, gates, fences, railings, staircases, awnings, wine cellar doors, furniture, and decorative home accents. Its 16 welding and fabrication stations, CNC plasma cutting department, and full-service powder coating line support both one-off designs and national shipment orders. A crew of more than 40 craftsmen handles design, fabrication, and installation, with eight dedicated installation and repair teams.

Customers range from residential homeowners seeking security doors and decorative railings to commercial contractors on projects such as the Summerlin Aquatic Center Phase Two. The company ships nationally and serves the architectural metalwork, home security, and landscape design markets.

Artistic Iron Works emphasizes a turnkey approach: it manages every installation detail, promises no hidden charges, works within any budget, and guarantees its estimates. The veteran-owned, family-run structure is cited as the foundation of its customer-service philosophy.

about:
Ascot Valley Foods operates from Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website notes over 80 years of experience in food creation. No founders are named.

The company specializes in round and formed frozen products, including appetizers and bite-sized formats, leveraging shaping and forming expertise to deliver consistent sizing, texture, and performance across production runs. It provides contract frozen food manufacturing and private label solutions, with in-house capabilities spanning product development, raw material sourcing, labeling, process engineering, and packaging. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Ascot serves food manufacturing companies across private label, retail, distribution, and broker channels, with a focus on the "Better For You" market. Its customer base ranges from start-ups to national brands, including private label customers, restaurant chains, co-packing clients, and broadline distributors. The company also supports vegetarian, vegan, and non-GMO product lines.

Ascot differentiates itself through its all-in-house model, which it says enables fast turnarounds, and its SQF Excellent Rating. Its narrow specialization in formed frozen products is presented as a deliberate strategy to ensure reliable, scalable results within a profitable niche.

about:
Assured Solar Energy is based in North Yarmouth, Maine, and has been operating since 2006. Taisey created Assured Solar Energy to bring his experience to residential, commercial, and agricultural customers throughout the state.

The firm specializes in the design and installation of photovoltaic (PV) arrays, offering both grid-tied and off-grid solar installations, battery backup solutions, EV fast chargers, and work on island and remote sites. With a team of more than 20 people, Assured Solar handles projects from initial design through installation and post-installation service.

Customers include homeowners, businesses, and farms across Maine. The company has installed systems for residential properties, commercial buildings, and agricultural operations, and also provides repair services for existing installations regardless of original installer.

name: AstroNova, Inc.
old_description: Michael J. Natalizia holds responsibility for overseeing all technology initiatives of the company. As an Executive Corporate Officer, he manages the research and development groups for all AstroNova business groups and leads their technological development. Mr. Natalizia has been with AstroNova since 1986 and has previously served as R&D Manager of the AstroNova Aerospace products, as R&D Manager of AstroNova Product Identification brands and as an engineer in the Test & Measurement products. He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in electrical engineering and computer science from Tufts University.
about:
AstroNova, Inc. is headquartered in West Warwick, Rhode Island. The company operates as a publicly traded corporation (Nasdaq: ALOT) and has been ISO 9001-certified since 1993, adding AS9100 certification in 2009 and FAA Part 145 repair station approval. While the exact founding year is not disclosed, the business has evolved into a global provider of data visualization technologies.

AstroNova designs, manufactures, distributes, and services specialized print technology and data acquisition systems. Its Aerospace segment produces ruggedized flight deck printers, networking hardware, and aerospace-grade supplies for commercial, business, and military aircraft. The Product Identification segment delivers end-to-end digital labeling solutions—including hardware, software, and consumables—for printing on paper, labels, paperboard, corrugated boxes, and bags. The Test & Measurement group supplies high-performance data acquisition systems used in structural testing, power monitoring, transportation validation, and industrial process optimization.

The company serves commercial aviation, business aviation, and military defense markets through its Aerospace division. Product Identification customers span life sciences, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, food and beverage, and cosmetics. Test & Measurement systems are deployed in aerospace and defense, power and utilities, transportation, automotive, and general industrial applications. Customers include OEMs, commercial printers, brand owners, airlines, and defense contractors.

AstroNova emphasizes innovation, responsiveness, and technical support as its competitive edge. A passionate commitment to quality drives zero-defect manufacturing and continuous improvement, underpinned by compliance with ISO, AS9100, FAA, RoHS, WEEE, and REACH standards.
